# Isaiah Chapter 51 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 23 verses]*

*Look to Abraham; comfort for Zion; Rahab cut in pieces; awake; cup of staggering removed*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 51 (Comfort for Zion) addresses look to abraham; comfort for zion; rahab cut in pieces; awake; cup of staggering removed. The key verse — "Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
